class A { protected n = 4 }

namespace N { export const n = 1 }

const o = { n: 1 } as const
;(o as { n: number }).n = 2

console.log(isNum(x))

function id<T>(x: T): T { return x }

function f(this: { n: number }, x: number) { return this.n + x }

class A { n!: number }

enum E { A = 1, B = "b" }
